books.author: Jagadishwarananda

sources.observation: Swami Jagadiswarananda authored biographical articles and recollections of Swami Ramakrishnananda in Udbodhan Patrika (48th year issue 11, 49th year issue 8). These form part of the compilation volume 'স্বামী রামকৃষ্ণানন্দের স্মৃতিমালা, তাঁর পত্র ও রচনাসংগ্রহ' (Udbodhan Karyalaya). No standalone monograph by this exact title/author currently in print.

books.text_outcome: no_complete_free_text_verified. Constituent articles exist in Udbodhan archives, but no standalone complete book facsimile verified on open digital libraries.

site:archive.org "The Story of a Dedicated Life" "Ramakrishnananda"

sources.observation: Originally published in 1948 by Sri Ramakrishna Math, Mylapore, Madras for the Golden Jubilee of Swami Ramakrishnananda's arrival in South India. Later in 1972 (Platinum Jubilee), this biographical work was revised, expanded, and superseded by Swami Tapasyananda's volume 'Swami Ramakrishnananda: The Apostle of Sri Ramakrishna to the South'.

books.text_outcome: no_complete_free_text_verified. Out of print 1948 standalone edition is not freely available in full digital facsimile on open institutional libraries.
